newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Table olive production higher yr/yr in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Table olive production higher yr/yr in 1996/97.

text.p: Global production of table olives is expected to surge to a record 1.2 million tonnes in the 1996/97 season from 0.95 million tonnes in 1995/96, the International Olive Oil Council (ICO) said.
Table olives represent about 15 percent of the total global output of olives, the IOC said in a statement released at a four-day conference in Lisbon, which ends later on Thursday.
The world's main table olive producers are the European Union, Turkey, the United States and Morocco. Spain is the biggest producer in the EU.
Global consumption of table olives has risen in recent years and was expected to reach 1.1 million tonnes in 1996/97, the IOC said.
Table olive production has benefited from favourable weather conditions and an increase in rainfall in the main producer countries, the statement said. --Lisbon newsroom +351-1-3538254
